_comment: Latitude/longitude boxes to draw candidate stations from, as [min_lat, max_lat, min_lon, max_lon] in degrees. Longitudes may be given in -180..180 or 0..360. These six 6x6 degree boxes match the named regions used elsewhere in the project. The global analysis in README.md instead used the bounding boxes of the continent bootstrap patches under processed/finetuning_output/pangu/<continent>/, which can be read straight off those zarr coordinates.
